thread:
Sara Park: Quick sync on the metering postmortem actions — want to lock owners and realistic timelines so we can close the loop. TL;DR: delayed token ingest on 3/28 caused ~2 days of undercounting and then a burst re-ingest that created invoice noise. Action list below, please reply with owner + ETA. :clipboard:

Sara Park: Actions I have so far:
• Identify root cause and patch ingestion lag (in progress)
• Backfill corrected token counts into ledger and flag affected invoices
• Create a customer-facing credit plan for impacted accounts > $500/mo
• Add regression alert for ingestion latency + dashboards
• Run a 14-day rolling audit to detect recurrence patterns

Diego Morales: I have the initial root cause — SQS consumer fell behind due to a retry storm from a transient downstream DB timeouts. Patch is a consumer-side backoff + circuit-breaker (PR 482). ETA: EOD tomorrow for canary, full rollout by Friday.

Priya Singh: For the ledger backfill I scoped the data required and estimated run time for the full span (48 hours of delayed data) — backfill job will take ~6 hours with current resources. Need owner for invoice adjustments; recommend finance + customer ops signoff. Proposed ETA: backfill run Thu night, invoice corrections Fri morning.

Eliot Chen: I'll own the backfill job and coordinate with Priya for the accounting side. I'll create runbook and test on staging today. Tagging `#eng-oncall` for a standby during the run.

Sara Park: @Eliot Chen thanks. Please add pre-checks: sample reconciliation for 10 accounts and a dry-run report. Also include a rollback plan.

Eliot Chen: Will do. Dry-run checklist:
```
- sample_accounts = select top 10 by usage where invoice_date between X and Y
- run backfill with --dry-run --emit-report
- compare token counts: new_count vs ledger_count
- produce CSV for finance review
```

Diego Morales: For the regression alert, I added a metric `metering.ingest_latency.p95` and an alert when p95 > 2s for 5m. Also added a runbook pointer and a pager to eng-sre. PR 486.

Priya Singh: On credits — recommend we auto-apply credits when corrected delta > $100 and notify CS for anything less. Draft credit policy: 100% of delta for top-tier customers, prorated for others. I'll put the draft in the billing-docs Confluence page and ping CS. ETA: policy doc by Thu.

billing-bot: Incident 2025-03-28-metering-ingest created ticket TKT-2154; linked PRs 482,486; scheduled backfill window Thu 23:00-05:00 UTC.

Sara Park: Notes on recurring patterns — Diego, can you run a 30-day query to see if we saw similar intermittents before? We should decide if this was a one-off retry storm or a recurring flakey downstream.

Diego Morales: Running that now. Preliminary: saw 3 smaller spikes in the last 30 days (shorter duration, lower volume). Will share a graph by EOD. If pattern holds we should invest in consumer-side batching + rate-limits.

Priya Singh: Finance ask: please tag every corrected invoice with `metering-correction` label and include original vs corrected amounts in the note. I'll prepare the customer email templates once Eliot posts the dry-run results.

Eliot Chen: Created runbook PR and a staging dry-run report attached to TKT-2154. Dry-run looks good for the sample accounts, deltas match expectations. Proceeding with production backfill Thu night.

Sara Park: Great. Summary of owners/ETAs:
• Root cause + patch: Diego — canary EOD tomorrow, full rollout Fri
• Backfill job + runbook: Eliot — production run Thu 23:00 UTC
• Invoice corrections & credit policy: Priya + Finance — policy Thu, corrections Fri morning
• Regression alerts + pager: Diego — merged (PR 486)
• 30-day recurrence analysis: Diego — EOD

Sara Park: If anyone can't meet these ETAs, flag ASAP. Otherwise I'll mark this as the remediation plan and we can close the postmortem when invoice corrections and the 14-day rolling audit are complete. :white_check_mark:

Diego Morales: All good from my side. :thumbsup:

Priya Singh: On track. Will post policy doc link when ready.

Eliot Chen: Ready for the production window. Will ping here when started and when complete.

Sara Park: Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll reconvene next Monday for a 1-week status if needed. :coffee:
